label.purpose: Buttons, menu items, summary pill (+0.2px), tile detail line.

data.purpose: Profile names, file paths, the profile combo.

data-small.purpose: Profile in the tile detail line; tile measurements: uptime, rates, compact total, server address.

shadows.name: tile-fall
shadows.purpose: Painted as 16 translucent layers reaching ~18px below running tiles; scales with the alive level; absent on stopped tiles.

shadows.name: tile-highlight
shadows.purpose: Top-edge highlight line on running tiles, inset 14px from the corners.

shadows.name: state-halo
shadows.purpose: Halo around the 7px state dot; breathes to .47 alpha while busy.

shadows.name: window-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(at 50% -10%, <muted→route-green> at 5–12% alpha, transparent 70%) over 80% of the window width
shadows.purpose: Overall-state atmosphere at the top of the window.

motion.name: route-crossfade
motion.purpose: OutCubic: tile border/tint, alive level, state dot color, window glow.

motion.name: switch-slide
motion.purpose: Route switch knob and track fill.

motion.name: busy-breath
motion.purpose: State dot halo while an action runs.

motion.name: trace-crossfade
motion.purpose: Traffic trace colour is mix(muted, route accent, route strength), so it rides the route cross-fade.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: Each column needs a 210px tile plus 14px gap; 1 to 4 columns.

breakpoints.name: compact-card
breakpoints.purpose: Card width below which rates collapse to one total on the server line and the address mask shortens.

traffic-trace.history: 40 samples at the 3s refresh (about two minutes)
traffic-trace.quietThreshold: 4 KiB/s (no trace when every sample is below)
traffic-trace.fill: vertical gradient, accent-mix at 10% alpha to 0
traffic-trace.line: 1.2px at 32% alpha; oldest 40px fade in from 0

narrative.overview:
VPNGo is a small dark board the user opens from the tray, reads in one glance, and closes. Every managed app is a tile, and the tile's light is its route: lit green while the app is on the VPN, unlit warm grey on the direct route, amber when the route cannot be confirmed, and sunk into the ground, hollow-dotted and dimmed, when the app is stopped. Color is read before any word; text confirms what the light already said.

The world is inherited, binding, from the owner's local search site: warm near-black neutrals, Inter for language, JetBrains Mono only for data, one connection color that carries state, 14px cards with an inset top highlight and a long soft shadow, and a faint radial glow at the top of the window that takes the overall state's color. Density is low and calm: three columns of 196px tiles at the default 760x520, generous inner space above the app name, nothing that looks like a settings table.

Motion is state, never decoration. Route changes cross-fade the tile border, top tint and state dot over 600ms ease-out; the window glow follows the same curve; a busy app's dot breathes its halo on an 1100ms sine loop. Refresh never moves or rebuilds a tile under the pointer or a focused control, and live figures never shift the layout: every rate sits in a fixed-width slot.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground with a single semantic accent (route green), plus amber for unverifiable routes and coral for failures.
Tiles are the only shadowed objects; everything else is flat with 1px hairlines.
Inter for words, JetBrains Mono for data and measurements: profile names, paths, addresses, uptime and rates.
Pills and rounded rectangles only; no sharp corners anywhere.
State is painted (dots, switch fill, border tint), and every state change animates.

rules.name: The Green Means On Rule
rules.body: Route green appears only where something is on, affirmative or focused: VPN route, checked box, success, keyboard focus, the overall glow. It never decorates a heading, a logo treatment or an idle control.

rules.name: The Mixed, Not Invented Rule
rules.body: Intermediate tones are mixes of the palette (hairline toward green, surface toward ground, muted toward ground), not new hexes. New states derive the same way.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Data and measurements set in JetBrains Mono: profile names, file paths, server addresses, uptime and transfer rates (units included, "58 kB/s", "4 h 59 min"). Route words, actions and labels set in Inter, even on the same line ("us · VPN"). One accepted exception, the owner's call: profile names inside QMenus (tile and tray menus) stay in Inter so they remain plain checkable items, one click deep and arrow-key navigable.

rules.name: The Compact Card Rule
rules.body: A card narrower than 260px is compact: the stacked ↓/↑ rates beside the name collapse into one combined total at the right of the server line, and the masked address shortens to one bullet per hidden part (146.70.•.•). A revealed address needs that room, so the total steps aside while the address is shown. The switch is the card's width, measured on every resize, not the window's. Dialogs: 420px minimum width, 24/22/24/20 padding, field caption 6px above its control, 10px between fields, actions right-aligned with 8px between.

rules.name: The Only Tiles Float Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to app tiles. Pills, buttons, inputs, menus, dialogs and the message bar stay flat and are separated by hairlines and tone.

dos: **Do** let the tile itself carry the route: border, top tint and dot change together over 600ms ease-out.
**Do** derive new tones by mixing palette colors (the Mixed, Not Invented Rule) instead of adding hexes.
**Do** set profile names, paths, addresses, uptime and rates in JetBrains Mono and every word around them in Inter.
**Do** give every live figure a fixed-width slot ("000 kB/s") so refreshes never move the text beside it.
**Do** keep a stopped app visibly sunk: no shadow, no highlight, dimmed title, hollow dot, "Iniciar" in place of the switch.
**Do** keep at most one bone primary button per view; everything else is a ghost pill.
**Do** update state in place; never move or rebuild a tile, menu or control the user is pointing at or focused on.
donts: **Don't** arrange apps as rows of names with a status column; apps are tiles on a board.
**Don't** use route green for anything that is not on, affirmative or focused.
**Don't** add shadows to anything but app tiles.
**Don't** introduce sharp corners or borders heavier than 1px.
**Don't** use mono for labels, actions or route words.
